faq.description: Bona ibisubizo ku bibazo bikunze kubazwa ku bijyanye na serivisi yacu.

security.question: Amakuru yanjye arinzwe gute kuri KIZERE?
security.answer: Dukoresha buryo bwo kurinda amakuru bwo ku rwego rwo hejuru kugira ngo turinde amakuru yawe. Amakuru yose yawe bwite n'ay'ibintu byawe arinzwe haba igihe yoherezwa cyangwa abitse, kandi dukora igenzura rya hato na hato kugira ngo tumenye neza ko amakuru yawe arinzwe.

items.question: Ni ibihe bintu nshobora kwandikisha?
items.answer: Urashobora kwandikisha hafi ya buri kintu cyose cy'agaciro harimo ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga, imitako, inyandiko, ibikoresho by'ubwiza, n'ibindi. Sisitemu yacu ikora neza cyane ku bintu bifite ibiranya byihariye nka serial numbers, IMEI, cyangwa ibindi biranga bihari.

lostFound.question: Uburyo bwo kugarura ibyabuze bukora gute?
lostFound.answer: Iyo hari umuntu ubonye ikintu cyawe, asikana (scan) kode QR iri kumwe nacyo. Ibi bihita bikumenyesha kandi bigaha uwakibonye uburyo bwirinzwe bwo kugushakira bitagaragaje amakuru yawe bwite kugeza ubihisemo.

limits.question: Ese hari umubare ntarengwa w'ibintu nkwiriye kwandikisha?
limits.answer: Konti zisanzwe zishobora kwandikisha kugeza ku bintu 5. Abafatanyabikorwa ba Premium bishobora kwandikisha ibintu bitagira mbibi kandi bakabona izindi serivisi nko gufashwa vuba n'uburyo bwisumbuye bwo kugarura ibyabuze.

faqs_page.title: Ibibazo Bikunze Kubazwa
faqs_page.subtitle: Byose ukeneye kumenya kuri KIZERE

questions.what_is_kizere_ans: KIZERE ni urubuga rwa mbere rwuzuye mu Rwanda rwo kwandikisha ibintu, kumenyesha ibyabuze n'ibyabonetse, no gucunga uburenganzira bwo gutunga. Dufasha kubaka umuco w'ubwizerane n'umutekano.
questions.is_it_free_ans: Gufungura konti isanzwe ni ubuntu. Kurinda ikintu cyo mu giciro cy'ibanze bishingiye kuri 2,000 RWF gusa.
questions.how_to_register_ans: Injira muri konti, kanda 'Andika Ikintu', maze ukurikize intambwe: tanga amakuru, shyiraho amafoto, kandi wemeze inyandiko z'uburenganzira.
questions.what_is_digital_cert_ans: Ni inyandiko yirinzwe mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga yemeza ko uri nyir'ikintu. Ikubiyemo amakuru y'ikintu, amafoto, n'ikiranga cyihariye.
questions.what_if_i_lose_it: Nyakora iki niba nataye ikintu cyanjye?
questions.what_if_i_lose_it_ans: Jya kuri 'Byabuze & Byabonetse', tanga raporo y'ikintu cyabuze, maze ugaragaze aho giheruka kuboneka n'igihe. Ubwenge bukorano bwacu n'abaturage bizagufasha kugishakisha.
questions.is_my_data_safe_ans: Yego, dukoresha uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru bwo ku rwego rwa banki kandi twubahiriza amateka y'u Rwanda ajyanye no kurinda amakuru bwite.

faqs_page.contact_us_text: Uragifite ibindi bibazo? Turi hano kugira nâ€™ugufashe kurinda ibintu byawe by'agaciro.

about_page.title: Kuki Hitamo KIZERE?
about_page.mission_text: Inshingano zacu ni ukubashoboza kurinda ibyanyu byose ntihagire na kimwe kizima mu Rwanda kirangirira mu bimenyetso bidatuye. Twatangiye uru rugendo kugira ngo buri Munyarwanda agire umutekano w'ibyo yakoze n'imvune ze.
about_page.vision_text: Twifuza u Rwanda ruzira ubujura bw'ibikoresho, aho buri wese afite icyizere cyuzuye ko ibye bishinganye. Jya muri uyu muryango w'abantu bashaka impinduka n'umutekano urambye.
about_page.story_text: KIZERE yavutse igihe twonse ko itakara ry'igikoresho atari amafaranga gusa ariko ari n'umutekano w'ibyo ubitseho. Twubatse ubu buryo ngo dukureho ubwoba, tubuze abajura aho bamenera.

howItWorksPage.heroSubtitle: Rejisitiri y'ikoranabuhanga yizewe cyane mu Rwanda mu kurinda ibyawe by'agaciro n'uko byakugarukira mu mutekano.
howItWorksPage.processSubtitle: Kuva ku kwandikisha kugeza ku kugarura, twatworoshya uburyo bwo kurinda ibigufitiye agaciro.
howItWorksPage.step1LongDesc: Tangira uha ikintu cyawe ikimenyetso cy'ikoranabuhanga. Andika serial numbers, IMEI kode, cyangwa ibindi biranga byihariye. Izi nyandiko zibikwa mu buryo bwizewe kandi zihujwe n'umwirondoro wawe.
howItWorksPage.step2LongDesc: Kwemeza nongeramo urundi rwego rw'ubwizerane bwuzuye. Shyiraho inyandiko z'ubugure, icyemezo, cyangwa amafoto asobanutse aranga ikintu. Sisitemu yacu irema icyemezo cy'umutungo cy'ikoranabuhanga cyemejwe.
howItWorksPage.step3LongDesc: Rema kandi ushyire akamenyetso ka QR ka KIZERE kihariye ku kintu cyawe. Aka kamenyetso gakora nk'ihuza rizewe hagati y'ikintu cyawe n'inyandiko yacyo y'ikoranabuhanga bitagaragaje amakuru yawe bwite.
howItWorksPage.step4LongDesc: Niba ikintu cyawe cyabuze, uwakibonye asikana (scan) akamenyetso gusa. Uhita uha ubutumwa bw'ako kanya, kandi twatworoshya inzira y'itumanaho ririnzwe kugira ngo ukigaruze mu mutekano.
howItWorksPage.benefit1Desc: Kuraho impaka ukoresheje gihamya y'umutungo ishobora kwemezwa kandi yizerwa.
howItWorksPage.benefit2Desc: Menyeshwa mu gihe hari umuntu usikanaye (scan) ikintu cyawe cyabuze, aho ari ho hose ku isi.
howItWorksPage.benefit3Desc: Garuza ibintu byawe utarinze kugaragaza amakuru yawe y'itumanaho ku bantu utazi.
